guide-entry-5664396aacac328d1fb27fc7.description: Report of the International Law Commission on the Work of its fourteenth session , 24 April to 29 June 1962 The Commission considered the inclusion of the topic on the basis of General Assembly resolution 1686 (XVI) of 18 December 1961. In principle, all members of the Commission were in favour of including the topic on its priority list, but there were divergent views concerning the scope of the topic and the best approach to its study. The Commission established the Subcommittee on Succession of States and Governments with the task preparing a preliminary report, and made several decisions on the basis of its suggestions. Discussion in plenary : 637th meeting (7 May 1962) and 668th meetings (26 June 1962) ILC Report, A/5209 (A/17/9), 1962, chap. III(I), paras. 49–56, 70–74 Yearbook, 1962, vol. II Yearbook, 1962, vol. I

Mr. Manfred Lachs was appointed as Special Rapporteur for the topic of the succession of States and Governments. Discussion in Plenary : 702nd meeting (18 June 1963) ILC Report, A/5509 (A/18/9), 1963, chap. IV(B), paras. 56–61 Yearbook, 1963, vol. II Yearbook, 1963, vol. I

guide-entry-d65aec90fb4732e5a3110567.description: Report of the International Law Commission on the work of its nineteenth session , 8 May to 14 July 1967 Divided the topic into three headings: a) Succession in respect of treaties; b) Succession in respect of rights and duties resulting from sources other than treaties and c) Succession in respect of membership of international organizations. Decided to give the topic of succession in respect of treaties a priority, and appointed Sir Humphrey Waldock as the Special Rapporteur to deal with succession in respect of treaties. The Commission also appointed Mr. Mohammed Bedjaoui as Special Rapporteur on the topic of succession in respect of rights and duties resulting from sources other than treaties. The Commission decided to leave aside for the time being the third aspect, without assigning it to a Special Rapporteur . ILC Report, A/6709/Rev.1 (A/22/9), 1967, chap. III(A)(1), paras. 36–41 Yearbook, 1967, vol. II
